722630202.text: Come on, what was with that person just now? The road's wide enough. They didn't have to walk straight at us like that!

722630203.text: No "sorry" or "excuse Paimon" either. They just walked right off!

722630206.text: Eh? This is... a small note? You mean that person slipped it onto you?

722630207.text: Quick, let's open it and see what it says!

722630208.text: The note has an image of a shuriken on it.

722630209.text: Huh, nothing to read over here. Just a windmill and a window.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head for the safehouse to investigate

722631502.text: See you, then. If you wish to know more about Lyudochka, you can ask the others.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the safehouse to look for Gendou Ringo

722630301.text: Well, look who's here. What? You've been staring since you came in.

722630302.text: Uh, Ms. Gendou, you look really different from before...

722630303.text: Did something change while we were out of contact? Don't worry, we'll do our best to help you out!

722630304.text: Changes? What are you talking about? Hmph. Forget worrying about me. You're the ones who were completely defenseless out there on the street.

722630307.text: Yup, that's the Gendou Ringo we know.

722630308.text: What are you two yammering about?

722630309.text: Oh, nothing, nothing! It's just good to see that you're well...

722630310.text: Hmph. For us ninja, every appearance is a disguise. I have a new mission now, so of course I no longer need that restrictive shrine maiden uniform.

722630311.text: Anyway, "Gendou Ringo" is still being used by that fake at the Grand Narukami Shrine, so use my new codename, "Momoyo." Got it?

722630314.text: ...Whatever. Now, back on topic. There is a reason why I haven't contacted you recently.

722630316.text: I guessed previously that the fake Gendou infiltrated the Shrine because she believed you to be Shuumatsuban members, and was thus preparing to infiltrate the Shuumatsuban itself.

722630317.text: Logically, she should be trying to contact you often, which will push the plan forward. But things have been oddly quiet there recently.

722630318.text: That's true. She hasn't given us any missions in quite a while.

722630319.text: Experience tells me that the Fatui must be "experiencing some changes" themselves. Perhaps they are planning to launch some truly large-scale operation...

722630321.text: That's why I looked for you today. I'm giving you a mission: figure out what the fake Gendou and the Fatui are plotting.

722630322.text: Should we actively seek her out?

722630323.text: No need. Let's not stir them up just yet.

722630324.text: Recently, we discovered three other undercover Fatui. Disguise yourself as one of their comrades and try to coax some intel out of them.

722630325.text: Ehhh? That's a super hard mission! How could you talk about it in such a relaxed manner?

722630326.text: Oh, quit complaining. I've already figured it out for you. Here, take this code sheet.

722630328.text: That's right. The Fatui's modus operandi differs greatly depending on which Harbinger they're under. This latest batch uses codes to ascertain their common allegiance.

722630329.text: The codes they commonly use are written here. Take it.

722630330.text: That sounds super cool. Let Paimon see, let Paimon see!

722630331.text: Wow, so many of these words are more like scrawls, and there's water damage too. Paimon can barely read it!

722630332.text: Water? Huh, might've been saliva, then.

722630334.text: Hmph. You'd best know that I somehow managed to snag that infiltration-specialist shortie to get this done. In fact, I'm impressed she actually managed to stay awake long enough to catch this much.

722630335.text: ...I think I know who you're talking about.

722630336.text: Whatever the case, memorize those codes, and the rest is up to you. Adapt, improvise, and overcome!

722630337.text: One of your three targets is <color=#00E1FFFF>disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.

722630338.text: The other two operate in Inazuma City. <color=#00E1FFFF>One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, started working in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs very recently</color>. Got that?

722630339.text: I'll be here in the safehouse for a few more days, preparing fake cadavers for a mission.

722630340.text: I've already marked the Fatui's locations out on the map. Go, and return quickly!

722631902.text: Alright, I'll rest up a bit further before going back to work. Working at a hot spring really makes you dizzy... That's how I let my Cryo abilities slip by mistake previously.

722631903.text: The Tenryou Commission hasn't stopped suspecting me over that, even now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Win the trust of the spy in Ritou

722630505.text: Hmm? Oh, I get it. You mean that you're also outlanders living in Ritou, right?

722630506.text: #(Uh, so he seems friendly enough, but Paimon thinks you got that one a teensy bit wrong, {NICKNAME}.)

722630530.text: Sorry. Could you leave me alone for a while? I'd like to rest for a few days.

722630531.text: (Looks like he doesn't trust us. We should study the codes we were given one more time.)

722630508.text: Oh? You seem pretty young, but you're "fellow countrymen," huh?

722630513.text: How long have you been in Inazuma? Have you gotten used to life here?

722630514.text: Not long, really, but we're doing alright.

722630515.text: Good, good. Well, I suppose you've met those "General Crabs," then? Those people really know how to give us trouble.

722630511.text: #(Oh, come on, {NICKNAME}, that's clearly not the right line!)

722630512.text: "Fellow conspirator," you say? That's quite the sense of humor you've got there. I suppose you, too, must be an outlander living in Ritou.

722631603.text: That's right — and we're going to put an "end" to you!

722632002.text: Wait. So you really *are* with Lyudochka, aren't you!?

722632005.text: Whatever! The way she keeps talking about other people just ticks Paimon off! Even Lyudochka wasn't this annoying!

subQuests.subQuestName: Win the trust of the spy in Inazuma City

722630801.text: Attempt to make contact with him.

722630802.text: Wow, you're pretty easy to find, aren't you?

722630803.text: ...What is it? You want to fight?

722630804.text: Oh, no, no, don't misunderstand. We've got something to ask you.

722630809.text: A man has no story. Only friends... or enemies.

722630810.text: (Wow. This guy's actually kinda cool... But come on, the code you gave was obviously wrong.)

722630840.text: (Looks like he isn't bothering with us anymore. We've got to pay more attention to those codes.)

722630813.text: #(What are you saying, {NICKNAME}!? That's way too far off the mark!)

722630815.text: (Look at his face, just look at that scary mug! Please stop using the wrong codes!)

722630816.text: No, no! Failure only comes when people "loosen their left hands."

722630817.text: That is why we must "clench our left hands." Yes, that's right.

722630818.text: (...Hmm, he seems to be off in his own world. Doesn't look like he's in the mood to bother with us right now.)

722630820.text: "Fellow countrymen" from the homeland... You're new?

722630821.text: Yup, that's right. That's why we came to say hello.

722630822.text: I see. Then, have you heard?

722630824.text: The "General Crabs" and "Sun Crabs," "clenched their right hands"... Our "fellow countrymen" went "hiking," encountered the "north wind."

722631803.text: So you are enemies. We must destroy the enemy. We must "clench our left hands"!

722632801.text: I took my eyes off her for a moment, and now she's gone...

722632802.text: Oh, my apologies. Do you need my help with something, by any chance?

722632803.text: Could we ask if you've hired a new employee recently? We'd just like to ask her a few things.

722632804.text: Oh, you must be referring to Tae. As it happens, I'm looking for her too.

722632805.text: She isn't very focused at work, and even skips out on her shift quite often. I bet she's hiding out somewhere right now, taking a break.

722632806.text: Somehow, there was an incident of a guest getting frostbite while she was on shift. So yes, she's a headache. In fact, I wonder if it might be better if she didn't come to work at all...

722632808.text: I don't think she'll have gone far. She should be slacking off in the courtyard by the cliff.

subQuests.subQuestName: Win the trust of the spy at the hot springs

722631101.text: Attempt to make contact with her.

722631102.text: We've got something to ask you...

722631103.text: Hmm? Who are you? Did that Mikawa Akane send you? Pfah. I just skipped a shift. You don't have to call people to catch me. Ugh!

722631105.text: What, are you from the Tenryou Commission, then? I already told you. I was on duty that day, yes, but I've got nothing to do with that case of frostbite, you hear?

722631106.text: Uh, we're not from the Tenryou Commission either. We're...

722631108.text: What? So you're "fellow countrymen"? You should've just said so!

722631109.text: But you didn't let us speak earlier...

722631110.text: What? Are you trying to start a fight with me?

722631112.text: (Ugh, and here Paimon thought that Momoyo had a terrible temper. This Fatui lady might be even worse...!)

722631121.text: Hmph. "Fellow countrymen," eh? If you've got nothing else to do, get out of my way.

722631122.text: This job is tiring as all get-out, and there's not a moment of peace and quiet to be found. Archon, I might as well go "wash the dishes"!

722631114.text: And what does your abandoning your homeland have to do with me? Wait. Are you stowaways? Well, if you're looking for my help, you're barking up the wrong tree!

722631115.text: (Uh-oh, you must've used the wrong code back there. She's got a terrifying look on her face!)

722631116.text: Leave! Or I'll set the Tenryou Commission's lackeys on you, and they'll lock you right up!

722631119.text: Colleagues? You work here as well? Then what are you looking for me for? If you've got a problem, go find Mikawa Akane or something!

722631120.text: #(That's not the code we're going for, {NICKNAME}. Look, she's ignoring us now.)

722631301.text: How long have you been in Inazuma? Have you gotten used to life here?

722631302.text: Not long, really, but we're doing alright.

722631303.text: Good, good. Well, I suppose you've met those "General Crabs," then? Those people really know how to give us trouble.

722631305.text: No kidding. Taxes used to be the worst thing ever around here in Ritou. They've actually gone down quite a lot after the recent abolition of the Vision Hunt Decree.

722631306.text: On the downside... *sigh* You know what? It's probably due to that incident with our Lady. Vigilance is at an all-time high. We can't act rashly.

722631309.text: Robbery? Surely you jest. They're with the Shogunate. Surely they wouldn't do such things!

722631310.text: (Uh oh, he's getting suspicious! You must've mixed up the lines that were related to crabs!)

722631401.text: Well, you're finally back. Did you manage to get any intel from them?

722631402.text: You tell Momoyo the details of the intelligence you got from the Fatui.

722631403.text: Hmph. Seriously, between the two of you talking over each other, your report was as clear as mud. But don't worry, I got the gist of it.

722631404.text: So, the fake at the shrine is named Lyudochka. Her superior has actually been pushing her to make further contact with you, but for some reason, she hasn't acted yet.

722631405.text: As such, this superior, whom they call "the Teacher," is going to give her a new assignment tonight. She will have to leave the shrine and go to Watatsumi Island.

722631406.text: That's exactly how it is, yes.

722631407.text: The details of this operation in Watatsumi Island is key intelligence. We must find some way to get our hands on it.

722631408.text: But we don't know where they're going to meet up...

722631409.text: We could follow her from the shrine.

722631410.text: That is so. But given that the area near the Grand Narukami Shrine is filled with mountain paths, we're quite likely to lose her.

722631413.text: Eh? Isn't this one of those Bamboo Slips you get from the Fortune Slip Box?

722631414.text: This is no ordinary Bamboo Slip. I've scattered some Shuumatsuban-made elemental powder on it. You can use Elemental Sight to see the traces left by the powder.

722631415.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now. We'll pretend to draw a Bamboo Slip, and then take the opportunity to get the powder onto her. Hehe, leave it to Paimon!

722631416.text: Stop waving that slip around! How are you supposed to identify the right target if that powder gets onto you as well, huh?

722631418.text: Hmph. Anyway, this powder is somewhat toxic, so fiddle with it willy-nilly at your own risk.

722631419.text: #(Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Momoyo seems really fierce, but she's actually a pretty nice person...)

722631420.text: Hey! Less jibber-jabber, more work! Any further delay and the sun's going to go down!

722630601.text: Oh? Are you looking for me?

722632101.text: What, need more detailed information? <color=#00E1FFFF>One of those three Fatui is disguised as someone from Sumeru and often hangs around Ritou by the seaside</color>. Very easy to spot.

722632102.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>The other two operate in Inazuma City. One, a man, is dressed as a merchant. The other, a woman, works in disguise at the Royal Hot Springs</color>. Got that?

722632103.text: What are you standing around for? Cadavers aren't that interesting — or are you interested in being used as raw materials to make one?

722632901.text: May I ask who you are...?

722632902.text: My name is Buzuleac, a merchant from Sumeru. I'm currently doing business in Ritou.

722632903.text: But I've been on break recently, so if you're here to talk business, could you come back in a few days?

722633106.text: If so, or if not... what is it to you?

722633302.text: What? Who died and made you the boss of me?
